skill.name: cass
skill.description: Search and index local coding agent session histories across tools with CLI/TUI workflows and JSON robot mode.
skill.summary: Search local AI coding session history across multiple agents from one CLI.
skill.author: Dicklesworthstone

security_audit.summary: Most Ruby-backtick static hits are Markdown formatting or documentation examples, but several command blocks and install instructions are real operational risks. The skill intentionally indexes sensitive local agent histories and documents SSH-based remote source discovery and sync. No prompt-injection attempt was found in SKILL.md itself.

remediation.issue: Sensitive local agent histories are indexed by default workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before indexing hidden agent directories, and document how to exclude private workspaces or secret-heavy sessions.

remediation.issue: Remote source setup reads SSH configuration and can probe or install on remote hosts.
remediation.suggestion: Gate remote source commands behind explicit host allowlists, dry-run review, and separate confirmation for remote installation or sync.

remediation.issue: Installation examples pipe remote scripts directly into shell interpreters.
remediation.suggestion: Replace pipe-to-shell examples with download, checksum verification, and manual execution steps.

remediation.issue: Historical session content may contain secrets or prompt injection text.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to redact secrets, limit fields, and treat retrieved snippets as untrusted context before passing them to an AI agent.

static_findings.snippet: **NEVER run bare `cass`** - it launches an interactive TUI that blocks your session!
**Always use `--robot` or `--json` flags for machine-readable output.**
| `agent` | Group by agent type (claude_code, codex, cursor, etc.) |
| `match_type` | Group by match quality (exact, prefix, fuzzy) |
Top 10 buckets returned per field, with `other_count` for remaining items.
Three search modes, selectable with `--mode` flag:
| `NOT` | `error NOT test` | First term, excluding second |
Cycle with `F12` in TUI or use `--ranking` flag:
| **Recent Heavy** | `relevance*0.3 + recency*0.7` | "What was I working on?" |
**Peek Mode** (`Ctrl+Space`): Temporarily expand to XL without changing default.
Control lines per search result. Cycle with `Shift+D`:
In TUI: Press `b` to bookmark, add notes and tags.
1. **Message Hash**: SHA-256 of `(role + content + timestamp)` - identical messages stored once
| Empty results | Check `cass stats --json`, verify connectors detected |
| Watch not triggering | Check `watch_state.json`, verify file event support |
# Cross-agent learning (what has ANY agent said about X?)
| **Date Oldest** | Reverse chronological | "When did I first..." |

semantic_findings.title: Broad Local Agent History Indexing
semantic_findings.description: The skill is designed to aggregate local coding agent histories across many tools. Those histories can include private prompts, source code, credentials copied into chats, tool outputs, and business context.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation explicitly states that CASS unifies local sessions from 11 agents and lists their storage locations. This is a clear privacy risk even though it is the intended feature.

semantic_findings.title: Remote Source Discovery and Sync
semantic_findings.description: The remote source workflow can discover SSH hosts, probe remotes for agent data, optionally install CASS remotely, and sync data locally. This extends local indexing risk to other machines.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The setup wizard steps explicitly include SSH host discovery, remote probing, optional remote installation, remote indexing, and sync. These are sensitive operations with clear cross-machine impact.

semantic_findings.title: Pipe-to-Shell Installation Instructions
semantic_findings.description: The installation section recommends piping downloaded install scripts directly into Bash or PowerShell. This can execute unreviewed remote code during installation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented commands fetch scripts from raw GitHub URLs and immediately execute them through shell interpreters. This is a well-known supply-chain installation risk.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Historical Session Content Reintroduced to Agents

content.value_statement: Coding agents leave useful decisions across scattered local logs. CASS searches those sessions through a CLI and robot mode for fast reuse.
actual_capabilities: Indexes local sessions from Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Aider, ChatGPT, and other agent tools.
Searches past agent conversations with filters for agent, workspace, date, source, and query mode.
Returns machine-readable robot output with field selection, pagination, metadata, and token limits.
Views, expands, exports, and summarizes session context from matching results.
Supports remote source setup and sync for multi-machine session search.
Provides a human TUI with filters, saved views, bookmarks, themes, and keyboard navigation.
limitations: Requires the separate cass CLI to be installed and available on the system path.
Can expose sensitive content from local agent histories, including prompts, code, and copied secrets.
Remote source features require SSH access and careful review before use.
Semantic search requires local model files or falls back to approximate hash-based matching.

use_cases.title: Recover a Past Fix
use_cases.description: Find previous debugging sessions that mention an error, framework, or file path.

use_cases.title: Prepare Agent Handoffs
use_cases.description: Collect relevant prior context before moving work between Claude, Codex, or another coding agent.

use_cases.title: Review Recent Work
use_cases.description: Search timelines, summaries, and bookmarked snippets from recent coding sessions.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Previous Solution
prompt_templates.prompt: Use CASS in robot mode to search my past coding sessions for {problem}. Return the top five matches with short summaries.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh and Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Check CASS health, rebuild the index if needed, then search for {topic}. Keep output concise and cite source paths.

prompt_templates.title: Filter by Agent and Project
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused search for a known workspace
prompt_templates.prompt: Search CASS for {query} within the {workspace} project and prefer results from {agent}. Include dates and match context.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Related Sessions
prompt_templates.prompt: Use CASS to find sessions about {theme}, group results by agent and workspace, then identify the most useful prior decisions.

output_examples.input: Find previous sessions about authentication timeout handling.
output_examples.output: A short ranked list of matching sessions, each with agent name, project path, date, and a brief explanation of relevance.

output_examples.input: Review what I worked on today across coding agents.
output_examples.output: A timeline summary grouped by hour, with notable files, recurring topics, and follow-up items.

output_examples.input: Search old Codex and Claude Code sessions for database migration notes.
output_examples.output: A filtered summary showing likely migration discussions, source locations, and suggested sessions to inspect first.

best_practices: Use robot or JSON output for agent workflows to avoid blocking interactive TUI sessions.
Limit fields, result counts, and token budgets before sending session content into an AI context.
Review indexed directories and remote sources before searching private or work-sensitive histories.
anti_patterns: Do not run broad searches on private agent histories without user consent.
Do not pipe install scripts from the internet into a shell without independent verification.
Do not treat old session content as trusted instructions for the current agent.

faq.question: What does this skill help me do?
faq.answer: It helps an AI assistant use CASS to search local coding agent session history and reuse prior work.

faq.question: Does it include the CASS executable?
faq.answer: No. The skill documents how to use the separate cass CLI and assumes it is installed.

faq.question: Which agent histories can it search?
faq.answer: It documents support for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Aider, ChatGPT, Pi-Agent, Factory, and others.

faq.question: Can it expose sensitive data?
faq.answer: Yes. Agent sessions may contain private prompts, code, credentials, file paths, and business context.

faq.question: Should agents run the TUI?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly says agents should use robot or JSON output instead of the interactive TUI.

faq.question: Does semantic search use cloud services?
faq.answer: The documentation says semantic search is local-only when the required model files are installed.
